race.title: Herefordshire Community Foundation Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Runner-up in a bumper at this course, LEGEND D'AIRY shaped as if he would be better for the experience on his first start over hurdles last month, so he could well leave that effort behind back at this venue. Dual bumper winner Saint Argente isn't taken lightly on hurdling debut, though, with Criminal also one to note. LEGEND D'AIRY (FR) SAINT ARGENTE (IRE) CRIMINAL
race.bettingForecast: Saint Argente (6/4), Legend D'airy (5/1), Criminal (6/1), Lady Kloppenheim (6/1), Trojan Truth (7/1), Sharu (10/1), Silverhill Freya (12/1), Lucky Bailly (16/1), Soizick (20/1), Desiderata (33/1), Dressed Overall (50/1), Himayta (66/1), Lady Of The Isles (150/1)
